capabilities: Render .nmr, .jdx, .jcamp, .csv, and .txt spectrum files via standard Obsidian embeds
Process raw Bruker NMR datasets with integration, multiplet brackets, J-coupling calculations, and peak picking
Plot FT-IR and cyclic voltammetry traces with electrochemistry tools like E1/2 calculation and peak detection
Simulate interactive spectra from ACS NMR strings in pubnmr code blocks
Export publication SVG figures and .jdx files, and copy ACS multi-proton strings
extras: The manifest carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Works fully offline on Desktop and Mobile; spectra adapt to Light/Dark themes.
motivation: Built to complement ChemEdit, providing a dedicated Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) experience in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian cannot render analytical chemistry spectrum files, so chemists must leave their vault to view or process NMR and FT-IR data.

relations.evidence: ChemSpec was built to complement ChemEdit, providing a dedicated Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) experience in Obsidian.

summary: Offline, interactive viewer for NMR, FT-IR, and cyclic voltammetry spectra embedded in notes, with processing and export tools.
